title: ImmuneLENS Nextflow parameters
description: One CSV manifest supplies BAMs and optional purity/local-CN correction values.

input.title: Input manifest
input.description: CSV with sample,bam and optional purity,genome,TCRA_cn,TCRB_cn,TCRG_cn,IGH_cn columns. A local path or s3:// URI is accepted.

outdir.title: Output directory (optional)
outdir.description: Defaults to <S3 manifest parent>/results/immunelens-<UTC timestamp>, or ./results for a local manifest.
